reviews.title: Worst Experience
reviews.text:
The Al experience has been quite disappointing. The responses often feel very basic, repetitive, and generic, rather than personalized or genuinely useful.
What hasbeen even more frustrating is my experience with customer support. HealthifyMe provides services to customers across different countries, yet i was told that support is available only during Indian time-zone hours. If you are serving customers internationally, how are customers outside India expected to conveniently reach your support team?
I'm also currently having trouble with the refund process. The overall experience gives the impression that it is much easier to sign up and purchase a service than it is to change a plan or get a refund when the experience doesn't meet expectations.
Health and wellness services require trust and good customer support. Unfortunately, based on my experience, HealthifyMe needs significant improvement in both the Al quality and its customer service and refund processes.

reviews.title: Giving 1 Star Only Because 0 Stars Is Not an Option
reviews.text: Be cautious before purchasing HealthifyMe’s plan. Despite paying a premium, the service was poorly coordinated. Diet plans were generic, preferences were ignored, follow-ups were lacking, and communication across time zones was extremely frustrating. A smart scale promised in 15 days was not delivered even after 31 days and counting. Support team and responses are pathetically delayed, and interactions felt insensitive rather than supportive. Overall, this did not feel like a premium health service and I would not recommend it to US-based customers atleast.

reviews.title: Do NOT buy the premium. Complete waste of money.
reviews.text:
I signed up for the premium only because of the AI calorie-tracking feature. As an engineer, I understand AI is not 100% accurate — but this is not a “small margin of error,” this is fundamentally broken.

Even with clear, readable nutrition labels in the photo, the AI snap failed to capture calorie and macro intake correctly. If it can’t reliably read basic nutrition information from a clean image, then this feature is not production-ready and absolutely not worth charging users for.

To make it worse, the customer support is terrible. I’ve reached out multiple times and responses take hours, if they respond at all. There’s no accountability, no urgency, and no real help.

reviews.title: Don’t take paid subscriptions
reviews.text:
Terrible experience – avoid paid subscription 

I strongly advise against committing to a long-term plan with this app. The so-called "diet coaches" are unprofessional and unreliable — they don’t stick to schedules and often don’t even bother to call.

I requested a cancellation within the first 24 hours of renewal of subscription, but the support process was a nightmare. They asked me to be available during a 12-hour window for a call — I had my phone in hand, and the moment it rang, it disconnected before I could even answer. Then they emailed saying, “we tried to call you,” and that was the end of it.

It feels like they are deliberately making it difficult to reach support, especially when it comes to refunds or cancellations. 

At this point, I doubt I’ll ever see my money again.

This has been a frustrating and disappointing experience. I regret signing up.

reviews.title: Very very bad customer service
reviews.text:
I am writing this review with pure, unadulterated fury. My experience with Healthify has been nothing short of a complete and utter nightmare, and I am here to warn anyone considering their services: STAY AWAY!

I placed an order for multiple devices, paid in full, and what did I receive? Expired products. Expired! This is not some minor inconvenience; this is a blatant disregard for customer safety and basic decency.

But the horror didn't end there. I attempted to rectify this situation, to get a refund or even an exchange. What followed was a Kafkaesque journey through their so-called "customer service." It was an endless cycle of:

Ignored requests: My pleas for a refund were met with complete silence.

Endless repetition: Every day, I spoke to a different person, each requiring me to explain the entire, infuriating saga from the beginning.

Empty promises: I was even given the runaround by a manager who swore they would send me documentation, proof of something. Of course, nothing ever materialized.

Six months of waiting: After half a year of fighting, I received one replacement device. And the battle for the rest of my money? Still ongoing.

Refusal of accountability: They even refused to provide a simple statement, as if they have something to hide.

This company operates with a level of incompetence and disregard that is truly staggering. They take your money, send you garbage, and then make it virtually impossible to get any resolution. And to add insult to injury, they have no presence in the US, making it even harder to hold them accountable.

Don't waste your money on this. It has some good capability but is clunky to use. Simple things such as repeating a meal are not easy to find. Taking pictures and chatting with the AI agent lead to super inconsistent results. For example: the same picture on two different days counted as 100 calories one day and 1200 calories the next. Then, there is no easy way to edit anything. 

I think there is promise - but this whole thing is a bit of an overdo on AI that is not ready yet. 

Worst thing is they lock you into a year subscription that is non-refundable. I used it for 3 days and am already regretting the decision to buy. Customer service was rude as usual.

reviews.title: Great idea, horrible execution!
reviews.text: Great idea, terrible execution. The food tracking is wildly inaccurate, whether you snap a picture or manually log your meals. Their database lacks many common foods, and even using the AI option with full nutrition facts still gives wrong results. It’s baffling—why does it insist a mini beef stick has 87 calories when it’s clearly 45? Save your money and stick to MyFitnessPal or Cronometer for far better accuracy. This app is not ready for prime time.
